message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine dated "10-16 FEBRUARI 2020." The primary subject is a humanoid figure wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie. This figure has a large, pale bulb of garlic in place of a head. The garlic skin appears thin and papery with vertical ridges. A pair of human eyes is visible, peeking through a horizontal gap in the garlic's outer layers. The figure’s hands, encased in shiny black gloves, are positioned in front of its chest as if pulling on or adjusting the right glove.

The background is a solid white. To the left, a thick vertical red stripe runs the length of the page. Large black text reads "INVESTIGASI JEJARING HITAM BAWANG PUTIH" and "IMPOR BAWANG PUTIH BERLUMUR KONGKALIKONG PENGUSAHA DAN PEJABAT NAKAL. JEJAK SUAP SAMPAI LEVEL MENTERI." At the top, text mentions "WASWAS VIRUS CORONA WUHAN" and "LAHAN JANGGAL JENDERAL RYAMIZARD." A barcode and the price "RP 45.000" are visible at the bottom left.
